meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 用户要求审计代码库时,Claude 会从九个维度(如架构、类型、测试、安全等)扫描技术债,并在仓库根目录生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,逐条标注文件位置、严重级别、预估工时和修改建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到 tech debt、code health 等触发词,或要求做代码库健康检查、架构评审、清理规划等时触发。

say.text: 帮我对这个代码库做一次技术债审计。
检查代码健康,列出最严重的问题。
say.note: 结果按严重程度排序,并附文件位置。

say.text: 哪些技术债该优先修?给个清单。
say.note: 会排出 Top 5 优先项和快速修复项。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude scans technical debt across nine dimensions (architecture, types, tests, security, etc.) and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md to the repo root with severity, effort, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like tech debt or code health, or asks for codebase health checks, architecture review, or cleanup planning.

say_en.text: Run a technical debt audit on this codebase.
say_en.note: Claude scans the repo and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md.

say_en.text: Check code health and list the most severe issues.
say_en.note: Results are ordered by severity with file locations.

say_en.text: Which tech debt should we fix first? Give a list.
say_en.note: It ranks top priorities and quick wins.
